rule: A place is in a hold when its location (an exterior cell's XLCN, or its worldspace's when the cell has none, or a room's XLCN) reaches that hold's location record through its parents. A building takes the hold of the places its doors open onto (where the doors that lead into it stand); a room with no location is walked through to the places its own doors open onto, and the nearest ring with a hold decides. Two holds there: the building's own location picks, when it is one of them. None: the building's own location. Otherwise the building is refused and left out.
